name: Frog with lá lốt
summary: Frog, skin on, stir-fried, with lá lốt added at the end. Người Lao Động is the publisher. It says the frogs are field frogs or garden frogs, and that the leaves are young.
origin: Củ Chi, on the Người Lao Động account of 6 Mar 2017. The paper says kitchens and tourism grounds in the district serve it.
howToEat: Người Lao Động: clean the frog, leave the skin, cut it in four, stir-fry until the skin is crisp and the meat is cooked through, then add lá lốt cut in half and take it off the heat.
No restaurant was named. No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival
seoTitle: Frog with lá lốt in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Frog stir-fried with lá lốt in Củ Chi, skin on, on the Người Lao Động account. The price is Check on arrival.
taste: Người Lao Động says the skin is crisp and the lá lốt is sweet, nutty, and fragrant.
